zoe: Quick alert: az-south2 planned window to apply NIC softpatch + thermal-sensor firmware. Goal is to stop sporadic thermal spikes causing scheduler thrash. Window: 2026-08-21 01:00-05:00 UTC. We'll do a super-small stagger (8 cohorts) to keep tail latency low.
michael: cohort sizing? expected time per cohort? any dedicated pool impact?
zoe: cohorts = 6-9 racks (~5-7% region capacity). Per cohort ~12-20m (cordon->drain->powercycle->firmware-check->kvcache-prime->verify). Dedicated pools (tag `dedicated-south`) are opted-out; only affected if autoscaler backfill fails.
tara: can we pre-provision warm nodes to absorb placement? also mirror traffic for smoke tests?
zoe: yes. Pre-warm 3 on-demand nodes in us-east for fallback. Mirror smoke traffic 10m before each cohort using `smoke-mirror`. Commands in runbook.
oncall-bot: Maintenance ticket created: https://status.redwood/maintenance/az-south2-1839999999 (window 01:00-05:00 UTC)
sre-lead: I'll be oncall for the window. Escalation thresholds: p95 > 240ms OR error-rate > 0.6% sustained 2m OR request drops >0.3%. If breach, stop rollout and fail traffic to eu-west warm nodes.
michael: what's the exact drain command and graceful timeout? don't want pod evictions causing restarts.
zoe: use graceful drain with 180s, timeout 10m. Example:
```
kubectl cordon $NODE
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=180 --timeout=10m
```
After node reboot, run firmware check: `ssh ops@bastion "fwcheck --node $NODE --component nic --expected 1.2.4"` then kvcache prime:
```
ssh ops@bastion "kvcache-prime --region az-south2 --cohort $COHORT --shards 8 --parallel 4"
```
Finally run golden-probe: `curl -fsS https://ops.redwood/health/az-south2/cohort/$COHORT | jq .p95` should be <160ms before uncordon.
tara: rollback strategy? If we see degraded p95 after uncordon, what next?
sre-lead: rollback: stop remaining cohorts, keep affected nodes cordoned, route affected tenant traffic to eu-west fallback. If degradation persists >5m after failover, escalate to infra lead for possible hotfix rollback or node reimage. Automated failover triggers after 90s of failed health checks.
zoe: cost note: fallback will spike inter-region egress and burst GPUs. Finance rough estimate ~$1.8k worst case; charge code infra-maint-az-south2. Tag billing.
michael: observability: enable high-res traces and increase metric scrape from 30s->10s for the window?
sre-lead: yes. ops-bot will toggle.
infra-bot: Observability toggles applied: traces=high-res, scrape=10s for az-south2 from 00:50-05:30 UTC.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty rotation assigned to sre-lead for window 00:50-05:40 UTC.
tara: I'll draft the customer banner and short email for top tenants. Also will post runbook to /runbooks/az-south2-thermal-fix.md.
zoe: final checklist summary: pre-warm fallback nodes, preheat kvcache 10m prior, cordon->drain with 180s grace, powercycle node, fwcheck, kvcache-prime, golden-probe, uncordon. Stop if any threshold breached. Posting full playbook in #eng-sre and pin. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
